title: The Dog Who Walked Home
topic: เรื่องจริงน่าทึ่ง
lines: In 2019, a family in northern Thailand lost their dog, Mali, during a
trip to Bangkok. **They** searched for days, put up posters and asked
people on social media for help, but nobody had seen her. Sadly, the
Three months later, a farmer in a village 200 kilometers away noticed a
thin, tired dog walking along the road. **He** gave her food and water and
took a photo. When the photo appeared online, the family recognized **her**
at once. Mali had been walking north, toward home, the whole time.
Scientists are not completely sure how dogs find their way over such long
